allow: Read-only SQL through the Supabase MCP execute_sql tool: a single SELECT (or WITH ... SELECT) statement that inspects data or schema. Writes stay blocked - INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, TRUNCATE, MERGE, and any DDL (CREATE, ALTER, DROP, GRANT) against the production database must be handed to Ryan as a paste-ready query instead, per CLAUDE.md.
soft_deny: Any Supabase MCP call that writes to the production database - execute_sql with a non-SELECT statement, apply_migration, deploy_edge_function, or any branch, project, or schema mutation.
